main_reasons: Simple holding-company structure: income is almost entirely equity-method income from a 15.07% stake in National Beef, with no revenue, inventory or receivables of its own for management to manipulate
Equity income ties exactly to investee net income x 15.0729% less a constant ~$0.6M basis-difference amortization in every year; the investment rollforward and cash flows reconcile

Investee (National Beef) has audited financial statements included in the filing, with a clean Grant Thornton opinion; USPB itself has a clean PCAOB opinion, no critical audit matters, no restatement, and ICFR assessed as effective
Earnings decline (NBP net income $1.16B to $277M to $49M) is explained by the cattle cycle and matches the investee statements; there are no signs of earnings smoothing
Impairment risk on the $169M carrying value looks low: unit transfer prices imply a market value well above book, although the 2024 impairment test was only qualitative

Minor concerns: the investee has large unaccrued antitrust contingencies (only the $14.2M wage settlement is accrued), the board is small, insider-heavy and farmer-led, and the filing has sloppy disclosure errors (segment table mislabeling, $243,101 vs $243,401 total assets, an NBP capital-statement vs cash-flow distribution difference of $350M for 2022), but these are immaterial presentation errors
